_comment: Tier-2 for kratos poisson: FALSIFIES the pre-2026-08-03 catalog claim that LaplacianElement2D3N and EulerianConvDiff2D3N 'differ by less than 1e-12 relative norm' with zero convection in a stationary solver. On the installed Kratos 10.4.0 they differ by relative norm 1.0: EulerianConvDiff2D3N assembles the consistent MASS matrix and NO diffusion term, so the stationary solve returns TEMPERATURE identically 0 with rc=0 and no warning, while LaplacianElement2D3N reproduces the sin(pi x)sin(pi y) manufactured solution (max T = 0.9755 vs exact 1.0). Element-level evidence: Laplacian LHS[0][0]=1.0 (P1 stiffness), Eulerian LHS[0][0]=0.08333=A/6 (mass), both RHS[0]=1.6667 (same source). Verified by execution 2026-08-03; catalog corrected in the same change.
